summary: New Character setting: keep the Studio Displays' rich low-volume bass, or tune it toward a neutral sound.
changes: Includes audio driver 1.3.0 with a new Character setting in Settings → Sound. Studio Displays add more bass the quieter they play; Character keeps that tuning (Studio Display, the default) or removes some of it (Warm, Balanced), up to Neutral, which keeps the balance the displays have at full volume at every volume.
Character follows each display's volume and changes smoothly, without clicks.
